description: Double-door Frost Free diagnostic extensions. Intended for the selected GL-N292RDSY example; verify all features and procedures against its exact manual before deployment. Common REF issues are referenced, not duplicated.

nodes.text_en: Does the exact model provide separate or distinct refrigerator/freezer temperature controls?
Are the relevant compartment settings at the recommended levels shown in the model manual?
After allowing the recommended stabilization time, are both compartments at the expected temperature?

diag_verify_compartment_controls.probable_cause: The control arrangement is not confirmed for the exact model.
diag_verify_compartment_controls.rag_query: double door refrigerator verify compartment temperature controls model
diag_verify_compartment_controls.technician_note: Check the model manual before telling the customer which control changes which compartment.

nodes.text_en: Which compartment is not cooling properly?
Are doors closing properly and are food items kept clear of the air outlets identified in the manual?
After correcting door closure or food placement, does the affected compartment cool normally?

diag_compartment_cooling_service.probable_cause: A compartment-specific cooling or air-circulation issue is possible; component failure is not confirmed.
diag_compartment_cooling_service.rag_query: Frost Free double door refrigerator one compartment not cooling
diag_compartment_cooling_service.technician_note: Record which compartment is affected and measured temperatures. A qualified technician should check the model-specific airflow and cooling system.

nodes.text_en: Is the exact refrigerator model confirmed as Frost Free?
Is there persistent heavy frost/ice inside the freezer or evidence that airflow is being blocked?
Are the freezer door and gasket closing properly without obvious gaps?

diag_verify_frost_free_design.probable_cause: Frost Free design is not confirmed; do not apply automatic-defrost guidance until model identity is verified.
diag_verify_frost_free_design.rag_query: refrigerator verify Frost Free model design
diag_verify_frost_free_design.technician_note: Confirm the model number and manufacturer manual.

diag_auto_defrost_service.probable_cause: Persistent internal frost in a confirmed Frost Free model may indicate an airflow, door-sealing, or defrost-system issue; further diagnosis is required.
diag_auto_defrost_service.rag_query: Frost Free refrigerator excessive internal frost automatic defrost inspection
diag_auto_defrost_service.technician_note: Do not instruct the customer to remove internal panels or test heaters/sensors. A qualified technician should follow the exact service manual.

nodes.text_en: Are food containers or packages blocking the model's documented air outlets or return paths?
After arranging items without blocking air paths and allowing stabilization time, has cooling become more even?

diag_airflow_service.probable_cause: Airflow imbalance is unresolved; the exact air path and system design must be verified for the model.
diag_airflow_service.rag_query: Frost Free double door refrigerator air circulation compartment temperature imbalance
diag_airflow_service.technician_note: Do not assume a specific fan or damper exists without verifying the exact model documentation.

nodes.text_en: Is one compartment much warmer or colder than the other during normal use?
Did the imbalance begin after a setting change, a large food load, or a door being left open?
After checking settings, door closure, and allowing stabilization, does the imbalance remain?

diag_imbalance_service.probable_cause: Persistent compartment temperature imbalance requires measured temperatures and model-specific diagnosis.
diag_imbalance_service.rag_query: double door refrigerator refrigerator freezer temperature imbalance diagnosis
diag_imbalance_service.technician_note: Document measured temperatures and the affected compartment. Do not assume fan, damper, sensor, or defrost failure without testing.

runtime_notes: Ask one question at a time and use the selected option to follow next_node.
If redirect_issue is present, transfer to that issue in the common or model-specific knowledge base.
Treat conclusion.probable_cause as a provisional triage hypothesis, not a confirmed component failure.
Use only actions supported by the exact model manual; do not instruct customers to open panels, handle wiring, or work on refrigerant systems.
Internal issue IDs are ApplianceCare AI identifiers, not manufacturer error codes.
